notes.title: 0.2.1 is now live!
notes.content:
Changelog:
- Some new creatures
- Health, Mana, Stamina bars, cursor and hunger warning can now be customized
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38980635/fb21cfc7ee22f3f628cbb2e6748f898dcc5e46e0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38980635/98b8eede418aa8e20e619142c3f19776d3010833.png[/img]
- Sliders for faster, easier and more precise customization
- Random button will help you create a unique color scheme for your character
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38980635/f1a63a1e2bd99a17be60d16fefbe52be94dec707.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38980635/6a4074d99a18c8108235eeac003cb506ab6f584f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38980635/40059372ae6221827b1b948d27dccd1fe6c05e03.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38980635/03a5d9faf23940b2184f8f8c73a641aab965d5d6.png[/img]
- Default button will bring back default colors
- Torch has new texture now
- Grass items are now cheaper to make
- Bows and arrows
- Minor bug fixes
